faq.seoDescription: Hardware, Mobile Money, fees, vouchers, contributors, and what to do when a router goes quiet.
faq.title: Everything owners usually ask.
faq.subtitle: Hardware, MoMo, fees, and what to do when a router goes quiet.
faq.ctaSubtitle: Message us on WhatsApp or start a free account and explore the dashboard. Longer how-tos live in Help.

items.a: SpaiHub is a hotspot billing platform for Cameroon operators. Subscribers pay with Mobile Money or redeem vouchers; you manage MikroTik locations, packages, and wallet withdrawals from one dashboard.
No. SpaiHub is built for MikroTik routers you already run. From the dashboard you copy a hotspot setup script (once) and a SpaiHub connection script (heartbeat + commands).
Through Campay on the captive portal — MTN MoMo or Orange Money. They approve on their phone and receive WiFi username and PIN immediately. Printed vouchers work when cash still rules.

Each successful MoMo sale credits your SpaiHub wallet after the {{fee}}% platform fee. Withdraw to your MoMo number from the wallet page. Voucher redemptions do not credit the wallet — they are prepaid stock you sold offline.
Creating an account is free. SpaiHub currently takes {{fee}}% of each successful MoMo sale (shown live from platform configuration).

items.q: Can one package serve several phones?
items.a: Yes. Packages support max shared devices for family or room plans. Subscribers can disconnect one device or end the session for everyone.

items.q: What if payment succeeds but WiFi does not?
items.a: SpaiHub recovers orphan Campay successes, keeps pending payments across reloads, and queues MikroTik grants. Owners must keep the connection script (commands scheduler) running on the router.
Start with the Help Center for step-by-step guides. Use the Contact page for WhatsApp when configured, or reach the SpaiTrace team via www.spaitrace.com.

A contributor sells spare uplink to a nearby SpaiHub hotspot over a local cable or wireless bridge. They do not run the hotspot or sell to end users — they earn by the gigabyte under an agreed rate cap and withdraw on MoMo.

items.q: Should I contribute bandwidth or run my own hotspot?
items.a: Run your own SpaiHub node if you want to sell WiFi to subscribers. Contribute if you prefer zero hotspot ops: plug a switch, let SpaiHub handle the link and metering, and get paid for unused capacity.

forMikrotik.title: Built for RouterOS hotspots.
forMikrotik.subtitle: SpaiHub does not replace your Hex — it talks to it. Heartbeat keeps status fresh; commands grant and kick subscribers.
forMikrotik.s1b: Existing hotspot overlay, or create a guest network (10.10.10.0/24) when needed — then walled garden, PAP, and branded login/status HTML.
forMikrotik.s2b: Schedulers for heartbeat (1m) and commands (15s). After import, the router acknowledges commands so grants do not get stuck as pending.
forMikrotik.onlineTitle: Online means the Hex is talking.
forMikrotik.onlineSub: If subscribers pay but never get online, check /system scheduler print — you need both spaihub-heartbeat and spaihub-commands. Heartbeat alone is not enough.

forContributors.seoDescription: Sell unused Starlink or fiber to a nearby SpaiHub hotspot over a local link. Metered by the gigabyte, paid on MoMo.
forContributors.title: Spare bandwidth. Local link. Credit on MoMo.
forContributors.lead: You do not run the hotspot. SpaiHub lands your extra uplink at a nearby site, meters gigabytes under an agreed cap, and you withdraw to MoMo.
forContributors.heroAlt: Network engineer configuring routers, switches, and cables for a SpaiHub uplink
forContributors.heroLead: Sell unused Starlink, fiber, or any home connection to a nearby SpaiHub hotspot — without running the hotspot yourself.
forContributors.howTitle: Plug a switch. We handle the rest.
forContributors.howSubtitle: Same neighborhood internet you already pay for — a second port becomes the line SpaiHub meters and pays for.
forContributors.s1b: A cheap dumb switch on your LAN. One port for your devices, one port for the line to the hotspot — cable if close, outdoor wireless bridge if you have line of sight.
forContributors.s2b: A technician lands your link on a dedicated port of the hotspot MikroTik, sets the rate cap you agreed, and monitors usage. You do not touch RouterOS.
forContributors.s3b: We meter what we actually pull under your cap. Your dashboard shows throughput, cap vs use, and cumulative GB — then withdraw to MoMo when you want.
forContributors.notVpnTitle: Not a VPN tunnel. Not cloud relay.
forContributors.notVpnSubtitle: Contribution is a local physical link into the hotspot router. That keeps latency low and avoids shipping user traffic through the cloud. Capacity is bonus layer for the site — not a promise to end users.
forContributors.ispNote: Check your ISP terms before joining. Consumer plans (including Starlink) may restrict resale. SpaiHub treats contributor uplinks as opportunistic capacity.
forContributors.ctaSubtitle: Create a contributor account. SpaiHub will match you to a nearby site and handle the physical link.
